title: Iron relative to hemoglobin did not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of airflow physiology
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2007–2008 to 2011–2012 transfer (n=3534/3469), adding log(serum iron/hemoglobin) splines changed survey-weighted FEV1/FVC MSE from 0.00468788 to 0.00469448 (delta +0.00000659; joint stratified PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.00004212, +0.00019475]). Incremental predictive benefit was not established; the interval permits benefit and harm. Source-only cross-validation and penalty selection did not establish improvement. Exploratory independently recruited cycle evaluation, not untouched confirmation or causality.
